g can sometimes be used as a legitimate way to access all kinds of data on the internet, it's also important to consider the legal implications. There are cases where scraping data may be considered illegal, or open you to the possibility of being sued.

This tool was created in part as a learning exercise and is shared in case others find it useful. If you do decide to use this tool to scrape a website it is your responsibility to ensure that what you are doing is legal.
